summary: Everyone knows these films and the misses are close calls (Jurassic World #11, Barbie #13). A tense, satisfying classic and an excellent Blitz.
reasons: Casual found 8 (Avatar, Titanic, Endgame, No Way Home, Black Panther, Infinity War, Top Gun, Avatar 2) but spent all 5 lives on Star Wars (#30, the 1977 film), Barbie #13, Jurassic World #11, Frozen #58 and Lion King #20: every miss tells you something.
Spider-Man: Brand New Day at #1 is the stretch answer and a real 'oh, it's that big' moment; fan went 10/10 with one life lost.
Blitz is deep: 29 of 31 quick casual names scored. Matcher handles short forms well (endgame, no way home, avatar 2, top gun, mario movie).
